label: P-H3-Image
notes: workflow.json is the source of truth from here on (Harry continues from it). Source: the ComfyUI gallery template image_p_h3_t2i (Pruna AI's P-H3-Image, free, local), fetched with comfy-mcp on 2026-11-15 and converted to API format by comfy-cli (`comfy run --print-prompt`). It is the LoRA route: the P-H3 LoRA on the MiniMax H3 fl2va video model, with Pruna's own text encoder, VAE and prompt upsampler.

Retitles: Save Image (16) -> nuke_save; Text (Prompt) (29:24) -> nuke_prompt; Load Diffusion Model (29:1) -> nuke_load_diffusion_model; If/Else Switch (29:23) -> nuke_enhance_switch; RandomNoise (29:12) -> nuke_random_noise; p-h3-image Conditioning (29:9) -> nuke_conditioning.

Aspect wiring, agreed with Harry on 2026-11-15 and copied from Pruna's own p-h3-image_text_to_image.json: the template typed 'Aspect ratio: 4:3\nRequest: ...' into the prompt primitive. That line now comes from a new StringFormat (29:40, 'Aspect ratio: {b}\nRequest: {a}') fed by nuke_prompt and a new PrimitiveString nuke_aspect (29:41), which Nuke fills with the nearest of aspect_ratios to the generation size. StringFormat feeds the upsampler (Generate Text, 29:33) only; with the upsampler off, the model gets the bare request, as in Pruna's workflow (the template sent it the aspect line too). nuke_prompt's default is now the bare request.
Width and height are bound on nuke_conditioning, replacing the links from the Resolution Selector (32), which is left orphaned.
The upsampler decodes greedily (sampling_mode off), so the seed only drives the image; the same request always gives the same expanded prompt.
The template samples with er_sde; Pruna's model card and own workflow use euler. Left as the template has it.

Claude generated with it from the CLI on 2026-11-15 (8 MP, 3872x2176, upsampler on, 48.2 s with models cold): the wiring runs, nuke_aspect was sent as 16:9, the upsampler expanded the request, and the sign text came out right. Harry generated from the Nuke GUI with the upsampler off on 2026-11-15: the bare-request path works.

knobs.name: model
knobs.tooltip: The MiniMax H3 base model the P-H3-Image LoRA is applied to (the first/last-frame video model). Variants differ in precision: higher is better quality but needs more VRAM and time.

knobs.name: enhance
knobs.label: enhance prompt
knobs.tooltip: Expand the request into a full scene description with Pruna's prompt upsampler before generating; the model renders full, specific prompts much better than short requests. The aspect ratio nearest the format is passed to it automatically. The expanded text appears in 'used prompt'.
